In this scenario, I would answer: 0 The idea that one deserves to have their husband cater to their every need may not align with Christian teachings on marriage and relationships. The Bible emphasizes mutual love, respect, and submission in marriage (Ephesians 5:21-33, 1 Peter 3:1-7). It encourages husbands and wives to serve and care for each other, rather than focusing on individual entitlement. In a Christian context, a healthy marriage is built on selflessness, communication, and teamwork, rather than one partner expecting to have all their needs met by the other.
